_comment: CCV-L23's declared feedback for ooe_sched (OA's rulings on TI-38, revs 187 and 191; DA's alignment amendment, 2026-10-23): the one-cycle select loop. The request and ready registers (stage 03) and their enables read the grant register (04) and its lead (05) back, the loop V-65's same-cycle confirmation needs; their frames are OI-45's. Each read's offset is the stages its tag lies past its reader's.

isg_cq02h.why: issued as ooe_rs's rule reads it: the grant leaving now, whose next value the request register feeds through the select (OA's rev 187)

rq_en_cq02h.why: the request register's enable: a grant leaving, and its own change bit, each fed back from the register it clocks (OA's rev 187)

ready_en_cq02h.why: the ready register's enable: a grant some row depends on left at the last edge, through the select and the grant register (OA's rev 191)
